name: Ice Cream Sandwich Vanilla
ingredients_raw: Inner Layer - Ice Cream (57%): Milk solids, sugar, dextrose, emulsifiers (471, 491), stabilizers (407, 412), artificial flavouring substances (vanilla); Outer Layer - Biscuit (43%): Refined wheat flour, sugar, palm oil, cocoa solids, maltodextrin, iodized salt, raising agents [500 (ii), 503 (ii)], antioxidant (319), emulsifier (322), artificial flavouring substances (vanilla), colour (150d).
